scope: Five publicly linked records in the Recently added funding for your studies in Finland section; the full catalogue requires registration. The five separate outbound-study links are excluded.

records.title: Agronomiliitto - Suomi kasvaa ruoasta training scholarships
records.summary: One-off training, thesis and required study-trip grants for Agronomiliitto members in the food sector. Membership and category-specific conditions apply.
records.amount_detail: EUR 250–950 for professional training; other categories have different amounts
records.study_level: Professional training; master's thesis; required study trip
records.brazil_criteria: Brazilian nationality not addressed; Agronomiliitto membership required
records.country_basis: Listed in the Finland guide; funding can include an outbound study trip, so Finland is not confirmed as the destination

records.title: Fortum and Neste Foundation scholarship
records.summary: Annual research grant for full-time doctoral or licentiate work in energy-related natural, technical or economic sciences, supervised by a Finnish institution.
records.amount_detail: Up to EUR 27,000 per year; other expense grants may be available
records.field_of_study: Energy-related natural, technical or economic sciences
records.brazil_criteria: All nationalities listed; Finnish institutional supervision and other conditions required
records.country_basis: Research may take place in Finland or abroad but requires supervision by a Finnish institution

records.title: U.S. Embassy Finland - Transatlantic Studies Scholarship
records.summary: Thesis research-cost grant for a student enrolled at a Finnish university or university of applied sciences, researching a topic linked to the United States. Living costs are excluded.
records.amount_detail: Up to USD 2,000 (approximately EUR 1,850), for research costs
records.field_of_study: Any field with a thesis related to the United States
records.nationality_listing: Finnish citizens or lawful permanent residents of Finland
records.brazil_criteria: Brazilian nationality alone does not qualify; Finnish citizenship or lawful permanent residence is required
records.country_basis: Applicant must already be enrolled at a Finnish institution

records.title: Foundation for Aalto University Science and Technology - Grants from the Foundation's own funds
records.summary: One-off living-expense grant for doctoral work at Aalto University. A separate research-visit grant funds a stay abroad; applicants must already be enrolled in an eligible Aalto school.
records.amount_detail: Living-expense grant approximately EUR 12,000–22,000; research-visit grant has a different range
records.field_of_study: Technology or architecture at eligible Aalto schools
records.brazil_criteria: All nationalities listed; prior doctoral enrolment at Aalto and school restrictions apply
records.country_basis: Living-expense grant supports doctoral work at Aalto in Finland; the separate research visit is abroad

records.title: Finnish Brain Foundation research grant
records.summary: Personal grant for brain and nervous-system research at a Finnish university, for doctoral-stage, postdoctoral or independent researchers. The source describes a 2026 call.
records.nationality_listing: All nationalities for research at a Finnish university
records.study_level: Doctoral stage; postdoctoral or independent research
records.brazil_criteria: All nationalities listed for research at a Finnish university; other criteria apply
records.country_basis: Research at a Finnish university; the 2026 call has ended and a new edition is not verified
